intent_en: To illustrate how store psychology influences a large proportion of purchases at IKEA to be unplanned.
previous_intent: To illustrate how IKEA's store psychology influences customers, leading to a significant majority of purchases being unplanned.
narration_support: and by one estimate 60 % of items purchased at Ikea are unplanned, nudged towards, in other words, by the store psychology.
chart_support: Pie chart and gauge chart with IKEA logos; the pie chart displays a large yellow sector representing the bulk of the circle, visually aligning with the high proportion mentioned.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links store psychology to a high percentage of unplanned purchases. The chart features a pie chart with a large yellow sector (roughly two-thirds) and a gauge chart, both branded with the IKEA logo, supporting the visual representation of a significant majority of unplanned items.
